04 · AUTO-QUOTE RULES

Your rates drive the quote.

Instant Quotes is a separate add-on. Manual quotes remain available without it.

  1. Look up the homeowner’s address and parcel.
  2. Confirm mowable grass area, access, and the service requested.
  3. Apply your approved rates, package, minimum, and service frequency.
  4. Send for owner review when information is missing or the job falls outside your rules.

Paid add-on activation, catalog publishing, and homeowner checkout are not connected in this preview. An AI model must never invent your prices.
